title: Jain-friendly eggless cakes for Marsden Park and Stanhope Gardens families
summary:
No onion. No garlic. No eggs. That's not a special request at Riverstone — it's the recipe.

Marsden Park and Stanhope Gardens families don't need to interrogate the buttercream before a Jain or vegetarian gathering. All 15 flavours, all six sizes — the sponge, the ganache, the fondant — are built eggless from the base recipe, which is why nothing changes when the guest list does. Nobody asks. Nobody needs to.

48 hours notice, minimum. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
